causes: home_hold_30s FAIL_SOURCE_CHANGED: a concurrent agent (Phase E) edited src/robotic_cutting_sim/goal_planner.py (opt-in cut_extent) during the case; the frozen source-integrity check rejected it (its holding gates otherwise passed); the compiled task id was unchanged

force_advance_2n / force_advance_5n FAIL_INCOMPLETE_WORKER_RESULT: runner bug, wp11_extra_metrics read a non-existent time_s from GraspMonitor reports whenever a SLIPPING/LOST report occurred; Kit exited Python in app.close() before the outer handler wrote the error. Fixed in 9a4cb5f (regression test added).

run_history.status: PRESERVED_PARTIAL (stopped after 3 cases; same buggy commit 0c39b23, pinned worktree)

tolerated_loads_end_held_v2_y.hold_gates_pass: HOME 30 s; TRIM (rho = 10 deg) 30 s gravity hold; HOME->TRIM->HOME at 1x (peak hand 1.86 rad/s) and 2x (3.70 rad/s) planner REORIENT rate; edge forces 0.1 and 0.5 N along -advance, -normal, +edge line; torques 0.01 and 0.05 N m about each edge axis; C4 rho = 10 deg reaction replay (peak 0.081 N) and its 10x (peak 0.81 N, reported)

torque_about_finger_axis.definition: HAND y = finger closing axis = v2_y blade normal; only pad friction (torsional) resists it
torque_about_finger_axis.held: 0.045 N m (0.5 N -advance at the 90 mm edge lever) and 0.05 N m pure torque about the blade normal: <= 0.13 mrad
torque_about_finger_axis.slips: 0.18 N m (2 N -advance): 218 mrad rotation, monitor SLIPPING from 0.52 s, never LOST, bilateral 1.0; 0.45 N m (5 N): LOST at 0.12 s
torque_about_finger_axis.note: C4 reaction peak is mostly along -blade normal (hand +y, into one finger); its finger-axis torque is ~0.0002 N m

negative_control_failure.cause: The -advance 0.1 N at the 90 mm lever gives -0.0090 N m about the finger axis, cancelling the +0.0083 N m gravity torque about that axis in the rho = 10 deg pose (net ~ -0.0007 N m), so at mu = 0.02 almost no friction torque is needed; the matching gravity-only low_friction_trim (diagnostic) did slip 450 mrad. The load sign was chosen before running from the C4 reaction direction; this is a protocol-design miss, not evidence that friction is ineffective.

analysis.diagnostic_prediction_check: low_friction_trim was predicted to possibly hold (weight mostly along the closing axis). Translation stayed small (3.6 mm) but the tool rotated 450 mrad about the finger axis under the 0.0083 N m gravity torque (monitor SLIPPING, not LOST): the prediction was wrong for rotation.
analysis.grip_settings: Commanded finger drive limit 20 N (0.5 N weak) and mu = 0.6 (0.02 low); initial finger opening 11.2 mm (v7 normal_grip). Measured handle contact force per finger ~18 N. The live runner/C5 uses ToolGraspConfig default 14 mm opening; both settle to PASS_STABLE_GRASP.

limits: Rigid probes only: material never advanced, no material contact, no cutting
rigid_probe_step uses zero joint-velocity targets (live uses feedforward); the planner knot rate is reproduced, the actual hand rate is measured
C4 replay is the kinematic reaction force only (torque not recorded); no C5 live reaction existed at freeze
Edge-frame world wrenches are fixed at the case start (not rotated with a slipping tool)
One seed, Native only (Isaac Lab NOT_RUN); provisional, uncalibrated friction, finger and tool parameters
release_trim lands on the PhysX board/riser (unintended contacts and 0.36 mm penetration after the fall); release gates do not include them
